headline: Mobile visitors got the premium site back: theme switching in both nav cohorts, reachable menu CTAs, and a hero that shows itself a second sooner.

items.title: Mobile drawer overhaul
items.insight: One close affordance, an opaque drawer in all 8 themes, a cookie banner that yields, and a fixed alignment leak that had clipped the first menu items above the scroll origin. The drawer's conversion CTAs are now always reachable on a phone.

items.title: CANON-047 theme parity on mobile, both nav cohorts
items.insight: The drawer theme pills were double-dead (never-called injector + width-unscoped display:none) and the 50% nav-sheet cohort had zero theme control. Both cohorts now offer all 7 themes via a shared VSTheme API, with a light-mode contrast fix.
items.evidence: assets/theme-toggle.js; assets/nav-sheet.js; probes pills=7 in drawer and sheet

items.title: Homepage hero reveal compressed to sub-0.8s
items.insight: The reveal stagger was still tuned for the retired v1 wordmark, leaving mobile CTAs invisible past 1.5s. The lede now completes within ~0.8s of activation; 900ms screenshots show the full hero.

items.title: Studio Hub trophy toast dedup + batching
items.insight: Every unlock announced twice (7 concurrent toasts on first load). One announcement surface remains, and 3+ same-load unlocks batch into a single summary toast.

items.title: S273 closeout-boundary gap found and closed
items.insight: check-closeout-boundary caught that S273 never rendered its closeout brief/cache — exactly the recovery class it was built for. The completed S274 boundary resolves it.

followUps: Ship the display-serif typography upgrade when studio-ops answers Ark cargo 01JT54BDHQ1A69BFA307974C0D (fontsource trust precedent).
Founder real-device pass on the new drawer/sheet theme pills.
SIL candidates: theme readability image-matrix gate; drawer/sheet parity contract.
